done_when: Close refuses a changed screen file that uses bold text, all-caps text, a background gradient, a hex colour outside the theme file, or motion of 300 ms or more, and the app baseline lists the rest of the owner's rules.
why: Builders can ship bold, all-caps, gradient, hex-coloured or slow-motion screens that close does not catch, because the owner's rules are not in the app baseline or in Forge's checker; the impeccable detector covers only some of them (gradient text, glow shadows, bounce easing).
